description:
Nobody turns everyday objects into life-saving solutions quite like Angus MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson). This Season 4 collection rounds up his most ingenious improvised builds, from clever chemistry tricks and makeshift tools to last-second rigs that get him out of impossible jams. A little science, a lot of quick thinking, and never a moment to spare.
